ki.gesamt: Only 75 % of the surface is in the colours of the brand.

punkte.text: 75 % of the surface is in the palette. The draft is built on colours that do not belong to txtme.
25 % of the surface is in saturated tones that are neither cyan nor pink. The brand knows no other signal colours.
62 % of the surface is pure white. The light surface of the brand is bone #efece6, text on black is off-white #f4f2ee.
Cyan and pink appear as signal, not as surface.
